scope: Independent review of three candidate JSON Schema expressions, their existing-Ajv in-memory validation and source/boundary documentation. This is an actual scoped engineering acceptance; it does not activate a Kernel wire, authorize an N/A layer, accept a runtime Profile instance, establish a control root or issue a GA.

sources.scope: Exact source/member mapping and candidate versus actual authority boundary
Root string example, original Vector fields and N/A requirement, exact Profile gate refs, GA and dynamic control boundaries; original L200 and L3435 were independently reread for this task
Exact PRE_ENTRY phase, required sets, 600-second limit and identity binding field names

findings: The original nine required fields preserve all four independent scope-ref/epoch pairs; foreign fields and substituted runner generations are rejected.

Each N/A layer requires paired explicit markers and that same layer's reason plus a reference/digest shaped as an accepted Schema reference. Numeric layers cannot carry that layer's N/A evidence. No defaults create N/A.
The marker/evidence layout, version-string type and nonnegative integer representation are explicitly candidate choices, not claims of an existing activated Schema.

All four numeric epochs now have the current JavaScript Number implementation's safe-integer ceiling. Out-of-range values fail closed; this does not amend the underlying S06 epoch domain or claim lossless support for arbitrary integers.
Purpose, isolated environment, isolated subject and quarantined candidate state are fixed to the existing phase. Candidate/controller separation is required.

R05-R10 and the fifteen required-true/seven required-false conditions are enforced as exact unique sets, so omissions, additions and duplicate substitutions cannot pass; incidental ordering is not required.
Gate refs require exact ID, definition version and digest plus the definition-set digest; per-grant maximum is constrained to 1-600 seconds.
Optional per-layer N/A permission syntax needs a reason and accepted-Schema reference shape; the candidate does not decide whether that permission actually exists.

Required exact source/target/artifact/Profile/actor/subject/Binding/scope/issuer/Audience/schema/stop/rollback/budget/sink/controller/fixture/stage/generation/Vector/signature input fields are present. Existing policy digest names and dominant_role are preserved.

AUTHORIZED, PRE_ENTRY purpose and isolated environment are fixed; omitted bindings, malformed hashes and type substitutions fail shape validation. gate_authorization_ref is not invented as a self-reference.

The root-generation string is explicitly an unresolved candidate encoding supported by the S06 L200 example, not a real value or proof of an accepted root. Ref carriers and independent generation types remain stated representation choices.

Date-time format uses Ajv full calendar validation. Expiry/current time, ordering, <=600s interval, Owner remaining window, reference equality and signature/issuer/root/Vector truth remain mandatory external checks, not claimed to follow from syntax.

resolved_findings.problem: Native JSON Number parsing collapsed source integers 9007199254740992 and 9007199254740993, while the original four epoch schemas accepted both rounded values.
resolved_findings.repair: All four Number epoch forms cap at 9007199254740991; README identifies this as candidate implementation capacity, not a new S06 rule.

resolved_findings.problem: The installed Ajv 6.15.0 default fast date-time check accepted nonexistent 2026-02-30T00:00:00Z.
resolved_findings.repair: Existing validator explicitly selects format full; added targeted calendar-negative and legitimate leap-date checks.

validation.original_ten_tests: Historical implementer 10/10 on original hashes, retained in README; not claimed rerun on the revised subject.
validation.targeted_implementer_run: node --test --test-name-pattern="review fix:" validate-candidates.test.mjs; recorded 2/2 passed, 0 failed/skipped.
validation.independent_recheck: After the fix, a single in-memory Ajv check confirmed all four unsafe epoch inputs reject and their safe boundary accepts; impossible February date rejects and 2024 leap date accepts. Actual validator full-format configuration was checked. Exit 0; no full suite, PQUAL or external execution.
validation.five_file_digest_and_lf_check: All exact final file hashes matched; all LF.

activation_boundary.samples: Synthetic unresolved references, old dates and non-signature strings exist only as in-memory test objects. They intentionally demonstrate shape acceptance without authority.
activation_boundary.not_an_na_permission: This review accepts the candidate expression, not a particular layer's N/A use. A future actual accepted Schema/Profile reference, purpose and applicability must be independently resolved before any such use.
activation_boundary.not_a_new_root: No root generation, issuer credential, public key or trust pin is supplied or changed. Missing real control-root state cannot be remedied by choosing an arbitrary string.

remaining_actual_dependencies: Bind any subsequently accepted operational expression and its full referenced-schema/validator dependency set through the existing authorized acceptance process; no automatic core responsibility-domain activation follows from this review.
Provide real current root/issuer-purpose/Audience/Schema/signature and authority-expiry/revocation evidence; obtain a separate scope decision if a new control trust anchor would be required.
Resolve exact Profile/fixture/Skill/controller/host/stage references and their independent acceptance; establish actual four-layer current state or legally accepted per-layer N/A with reasons.
Enforce actual time relationships, <=600s GA, Owner budget/window, remote durable Intent, stopping and UNKNOWN behavior before any qualifying execution.
